name: Pashur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: This is where the opposition against Jeremiah starts. “Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things”: he heard that Jeremiah was prophesying against Jerusalem. He had power and a position.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: “Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of the Lord, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things”: the wars and the judgment that Jeremiah prophesied against their wickedness.

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: Pashur the priest, chief governor in the house of the Most High, hears Jeremiah prophesy, smites him, and puts him in the stocks in the high gate of Benjamin.

note.label: Jeremiah 20: The Prophet's Fire Shut Up in His Bones

points: “Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet”: he smacked him in the face, “and put him in the stocks”, put him in jail, “that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.”

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: “Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet”: he beat him up, just for prophesying the truth, “and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of the Lord.”

note.label: A FIRE SHUT UP IN MY BONES : THE WORK THE ZEAL THE FIRE

points: All Judah, all the strength and treasures of the city, and Pashur's whole household will be carried captive to Babylon, and Pashur will die there and be buried there with all the friends to whom he prophesied lies.

note.label: Jeremiah 20: The Prophet's Fire Shut Up in His Bones

points: “And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thine house shall go into captivity: and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and shalt be buried there, thou, and all thy friends, to whom thou hast prophesied lies.” Pashur was teaching lies.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah
